يهررن (form I)
# يَهْرِرْنَ (yahrirna) /jah.rir.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra)
# يُهْرَرْنَ (yuhrarna) /juh.rar.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
